headline: BOTH ROUND-10 BLOCKERS ARE GENUINELY CLOSED, AND THE POSITIVE CLAIMS OF THIS ROUND ARE THE STRONGEST THIS ITEM HAS PRODUCED - I RE-MEASURED EVERY ONE RATHER THAN READING IT. R10-B1: no loader literal in any spec_from_file_location/module_from_spec/exec_module call of the twelve modules is a declared source unit (my own AST sweep over 60 loader sites finds the list EMPTY), 'entropy.py' IS in a module-level loader call at 58570e1 and is GONE, and the dashboard now resolves the entropy owner through readers.load_owners. R10-B2 is closed by a KIND TEST, which is the only thing that can close a blocking open. THE SIX-PATH DIFFERENTIAL REPRODUCES EXACTLY on engines assembled from git: a FIFO at each of .warp/events.jsonl, .warp/entropy.py, .warp/validate.py, .warp/incident.py, .warp/intent_corpus.py and one spec file of the corpus HANGS ALL FOUR SURFACES on the round-10 engine - 24 of 24 hung, zero bytes, no exit code - and 0 of 24 on this one, with the declared source NAMED on all four surfaces of every cell, reaching NINE of the thirteen rows exactly as claimed, four of the six being module loads. THE 208-CELL MATRIX REPRODUCES CELL FOR CELL: I rebuilt all 13 x 4 configurations myself and every one of the 208 runs exits 0 with non-empty stdout, no traceback, the source named on all four surfaces, and support.renderable false on the machine surface - ZERO bad cells. THE LABEL DIFF REPRODUCES FOR THE FIRST TIME IN FOUR ROUNDS: instrumenting expect() in detached worktrees gives 3156 labels at 58570e1 and 3166 at 9863a7d, zero duplicates at either, 20 APPEAR and 10 DISAPPEAR - the published figure exactly - and I diffed all ten pairs and every disappearance is a restatement whose enforced condition survives. The false clause 'because the two derivations may not import each other' is genuinely DELETED and the three cross-derivation bindings are MEASURED in the assertion body. THE ITEM FAILS ON ONE REAL UNDECLARED DEFECT THAT IS THE SAME HARM AS R10-B2 AT FOUR MORE PATHS, ON ONE MEASURABLY FALSE SENTENCE PUBLISHED THREE TIMES, AND ON A GATE-COST REGRESSION I RULE A DEFECT. (1) A FIFO AT proof/*/manifest.json, proof/*/verdict*.json, plans/*.md OR .warp/decisions/*.yaml HANGS ALL FOUR SURFACES FOREVER - zero bytes, no exit code, killed by my timeout - because the declared kind test in front of the corpus delegation covers only specs/ entries while the owner it delegates to (intent_corpus.build_corpus) opens FOUR MORE ROOTS with bare read_text(). The harm is charged to the DECLARED SOURCE spec_corpus, which names nothing at all, and it refutes the shipped module's own universal at .warp/metrics_read_kind.py:23-25 word for word. This repository ships 133 proof manifests, 146 verdicts and 18 plans. (2) proof/WARP-1210/manifest.json says THREE TIMES that metrics_shape_readers.py 'went DOWN from 298 to 299', 'came DOWN to 299 from 298' and that 'the delegation boundary REMOVED lines from it': 298 to 299 is UP, and the numstat is 16 added and 15 removed for net +1. (3) THE GATE DOUBLED - I measured 4:12.18 wall clock and selftest 115.86s -> 237.76s (2.05x) - while a committed programme to bring the gate UNDER 20 SECONDS is in flight, and the regression is DECLARED NOWHERE in the shipped record: no wall-clock figure appears in the manifest or the spec at all. 96 of the 122 added seconds are DELIBERATE HANGING on cells that are expected to hang, which a shorter per-cell timeout would prove identically and MORE safely.

must_fix_before_live.severity: blocking - a REAL DEFECT with FOUR members, the IDENTICAL harm round 10 blocked on, UNDECLARED, and refuting the shipped module's own universal
must_fix_before_live.summary: A FIFO AT ANY OF FOUR PATHS THE DELEGATED CORPUS OWNER OPENS MAKES ALL FOUR SURFACES HANG FOREVER: no stdout, no stderr, no exit code. MEASURED on relocated engines built exactly the way scripts/selftest.py builds them, on the SHIPPED round-11 tree, with no memory ceiling: `.warp/metrics.py', `--json', `.warp/dashboard.py' and `--html' each ran past a 20-second and then an 8-second timeout with ZERO bytes written, for each of (a) a FIFO at `proof/WARP-0001/manifest.json', (b) a FIFO at `proof/WARP-0001/verdict-1.json', (c) a FIFO at `plans/PLAN-0001.md', (d) a FIFO at `.warp/decisions/DEC-1.yaml'. 16 of 16 surface runs HUNG; the declared source `spec_corpus' appears in ZERO of them. THE PATH IS THIS ROUND'S OWN DELEGATION. .warp/metrics_shape_readers.py:142 is `spec_ids, delegation = delegated(specs_dir, lambda: IC.open_corpus(root).spec_ids(), True, [])' and the store kind test it asks is `unopenable_entry(unit)' over the TOP-LEVEL ENTRIES OF specs/ ONLY (.warp/metrics_read_kind.py:190, :154-175). The owner it hands the read to opens FOUR MORE ROOTS with a bare `read_text()' and no kind test: .warp/intent_corpus.py:236 (`proof/*/manifest.json'), :263 (`proof/*/verdict*.json'), .warp/validate.py:651 through `plan_registry` (`plans/*.md'), and .warp/decision.py:77 through `load_record` (`.warp/decisions/*.yaml'). A whole-file read of a FIFO blocks until a writer appears, so nothing raises and no handler, no declared exception set and no `except Exception' at the delegation boundary can reach it - which is the exact structural fact this round is built on. THE HONEST ANSWER IS THREE FUNCTIONS AWAY IN THE SAME FILE, which is R10-B2's shape repeated verbatim: .warp/intent_corpus.py:282 `_read_events' does `if not p.is_file(): return out' before its read, while :211, :236 and :263 do not. IT REFUTES A SHIPPED UNIVERSAL, WORD FOR WORD. .warp/metrics_read_kind.py:23-25, present in ALL EIGHT engine copies, states `EVERY DECLARED SOURCE HAS A READ UNIT, and every code path that can make one unavailable answers with that source's own name on all four surfaces, HOWEVER the unit is reached and WHETHER the failure raises or BLOCKS.' Four code paths make `spec_corpus' unavailable and NO surface answers with any name. AND IT REFUTES THE SPEC SENTENCE THIS ROUND ADDED: specs/WARP-1210-the-support-numbers.md:98-99 widens the class to `A DECLARED SOURCE BECOMES UNAVAILABLE AND SOME SURFACE PRINTS NOTHING AT ALL - HOWEVER THE SOURCE IS REACHED, AND WHETHER THE FAILURE RAISES OR BLOCKS'. The round widened the criterion and then failed the widened criterion. NOT DECLARED, AND THE DECLARED BOUNDARY DOES NOT COVER IT: the manifest's out-of-domain paragraph (assumptions[4]) names exactly ONE out-of-domain read - the entropy owner's static-shape file enumeration - and PROBES it. I reproduced that probe and it is genuinely safe (a FIFO at `scripts/check_pack_drift.py' leaves all four surfaces alive, because `_area_source_files' filters on `is_file()'). But one convenient path probed safe is not a boundary: the paragraph does not enumerate the corpus owner's other four read roots, and four of them are not safe. That is this item's own recorded method lesson - `a property EXHIBITED over one convenient fixture rather than ENFORCED' - committed a fifth time. NOT A ROUND-11 REGRESSION: identical on the round-10 tree assembled from git (24 of 24 hung there too), which is exactly the standing of R10-B2 and R9-B1(b) when the previous two rounds blocked on them. REACHABLE IN A REAL REPOSITORY, not only in a fixture: this repository ships 133 `proof/*/manifest.json', 146 `proof/*/verdict*.json' and 18 `plans/*.md' right now. THE FIX IS THE ONE ALREADY BUILT: ask `unopenable_entry' over the roots the owner actually reads (proof/, plans/, the decisions dir) at the same delegation, or put `is_file()' in front of the four reads that lack it. The declaration-keyed rule is the right key; it was quantified over the units the pass reads ITSELF and not over the units it HANDS TO AN OWNER, and the fifth taxonomy is one root short in exactly the way the previous four were one name short.

must_fix_before_live.summary: THE SHAPE-READERS LINE COUNT WENT UP, NOT DOWN, AND THE MANIFEST SAYS DOWN THREE TIMES. MEASURED with wc -l and git: `.warp/metrics_shape_readers.py' is 298 lines at 58570e1 and 299 lines at 9863a7d, and `git diff --numstat 58570e1 9863a7d' reports `16 15' for that file - sixteen added, fifteen removed, NET PLUS ONE. The three published sentences: (a) proof/WARP-1210/manifest.json:20 (AC1 evidence) `metrics_shape_readers.py went DOWN from 298 to 299 of its unchanged 300 rather than up' - which is self-contradictory on its face as well as false; (b) proof/WARP-1210/manifest.json:198 (checks.bounds) `metrics_shape_readers came DOWN to 299 from 298 of 300 - the delegation boundary REMOVED lines from it'; (c) proof/WARP-1210/manifest.json:248 (assumptions[1]) `metrics_shape_readers.py went DOWN to 299 of its unchanged 300 because the delegation boundary removed lines from it'. WHY IT IS NOT COSMETIC: this is the load-bearing evidence for the SPLIT. The argument for adding a twelfth module is that two modules stood at their declared bounds, that a bound may not be relaxed, and that the split therefore brought a module DOWN rather than compressing declarations. The measurement says the split left the shape readers ONE LINE CLOSER to their bound (2 free before, 1 free after), so the direction of the only evidence offered for the split's necessity is inverted. The same check block states `ZERO at ... metrics_shape_readers (299/300)' four clauses earlier, so the manifest contradicts itself inside one field. THE ASSERTION ITSELF IS CAREFUL AND TRUE - scripts/selftest.py:19561 says only `the shape readers are now BELOW that bound', which holds - so this is a manifest-only defect and the remedy is the owner's standing one: delete the three sentences or replace them with the measurement (298 -> 299, +1, sixteen added and fifteen removed). EIGHT of the eleven rounds have now failed at least partly on a published figure that does not reproduce, and this is the second consecutive round where the FALSE FIGURE IS IN THE BOUND ACCOUNTING SPECIFICALLY.

must_fix_before_live.severity: blocking - a DEFECT rather than a tradeoff: a 2.05x gate-cost regression that is UNDECLARED in the shipped record, conflicts with a committed objective, and is ~79 percent avoidable at STRICTLY BETTER flakiness margin
must_fix_before_live.summary: THE GATE DOUBLED AND THE SHIPPED RECORD DOES NOT MENTION IT. MEASURED BY ME: `./scripts/verify.sh' at 063c33b ran GREEN, exit 0, in 4:12.18 wall clock (31 percent CPU on 20 cores - most of the wall time is WAITING); `python3 scripts/selftest.py' is 237.76s at HEAD against 115.86s in a detached worktree at 58570e1, a factor of 2.052, both green (3166/0 and 3156/0). The claimed figures are therefore CONFIRMED, not refuted. IT IS DECLARED NOWHERE THE OWNER WOULD READ IT: I grepped proof/WARP-1210/manifest.json and specs/WARP-1210-the-support-numbers.md for every form of gate cost, wall clock, elapsed, minutes, seconds, slower and subprocess. The manifest says `208 cells' (four times), `52 relocated engines' and `a 20-SECOND TIMEOUT'; it states no wall-clock figure and no cost at all. The spec says `TIMEOUT' once. A reader of the shipped artifacts cannot learn that this item doubled the gate. THE CONFLICT IS WITH A COMMITTED NUMBER, not a preference: the gate-cost programme's own plan commits to `the gate under 20 seconds from 117.1' and four specs exist to deliver it. I measured the round-11 gate at 252.2s myself; I did NOT re-run the round-10 GATE, so the 117.1s is the programme's own stated baseline and the like-for-like figure I measured is the SELFTEST at 115.86s versus 237.76s. On the programme's own baseline the reduction still owed goes from 5.9x to 12.6x, and one of the four items (WARP-0714) is already sequenced to touch scripts/selftest.py after WARP-1210 lands. WHY DEFECT AND NOT TRADEOFF, stated as the arithmetic: of the 121.9 added selftest seconds, 96 are 24 cells x 4 seconds of DELIBERATE HANGING (scripts/selftest.py:19303, `_M10_R11_DIFF_TIMEOUT = 4'), leaving ~26 seconds for the 280 real subprocess runs and 77 engine builds. Those 24 runs are the SIX FIFO differential cells on the round-10 engine, where ALL FOUR surfaces are EXPECTED to hang - a blocking read is INFINITE, so any timeout proves it, and no cell in a FIFO row has to succeed. The harness applies ONE timeout per cell (scripts/selftest.py:19441), so 4 seconds is simultaneously (i) 4x longer than the hang proof needs and (ii) the ONLY margin protecting the 12 round-10-engine metrics runs that MUST succeed and be byte-equal. Splitting it - 1 second for the six expected-hang rows, 20 seconds for the six must-succeed rows - saves 72 of the 122 added seconds AND RAISES the thinnest flakiness margin from 4x to 20x. A change that is both cheaper and safer, proving the identical property, was not examined. SECOND AVOIDABLE COST, measured from the table itself: the 13 declared rows resolve to only NINE DISTINCT (target) values, because spec_area_index resolves to the same spec file as spec_corpus, area_cost_series to the same entropy.py as entropy_series_owner, incident_timeline to the same incident record as incident_record_store, and incident_contract_owner to the same incident.py as incident_vocabulary. Four of the 52 cells x 4 shapes therefore rebuild an engine and re-run four processes over a filesystem state ALREADY EXERCISED by another cell - 16 redundant engine builds and 64 redundant subprocess runs, about 30 percent of the matrix - and the only property the duplicate adds is `this row names ITSELF', which one engine per distinct (target, shape) could assert for every riding row at once (36 engines, 144 runs). WHAT THE OWNER IS GETTING FOR THE MONEY, said plainly because it is real: the 208-cell matrix and the differential are the coverage that finally makes this defect class checkable AT THE DECLARATION, and they caught 24 genuine hangs a green gate had shipped through ten rounds. The COVERAGE is worth having. It is the COST SHAPE that is the defect: undeclared, 79 percent concentrated in a timeout that could be shorter and safer, and 30 percent duplicated. THE FIX IS THREE SMALL CHANGES AND ONE PARAGRAPH: split the differential timeout by expectation, collapse the matrix to its distinct configurations, consider whether a 208-process crossing belongs in the every-commit gate or in a slower suite the speed programme is already designing, and DECLARE the wall clock in the manifest so the next reader does not have to measure it.

spec_edit_ruling: THE SPEC EDIT IS AN HONEST STRENGTHENING AND I WENT LOOKING FOR A WEAKENING. The observability block replaces the round-10 formulation (`AN EXCEPTION RAISED WHILE READING A RECORDED ARTIFACT, WHICH NO HANDLER NAMES, EXITS ALL FOUR SURFACES PRINTING NOTHING' plus `EVERY READ OF A RECORDED ARTIFACT IN THIS PASS THEREFORE SITS INSIDE A HANDLER') with a strictly WIDER one at specs/WARP-1210-the-support-numbers.md:96-110: `A DECLARED SOURCE BECOMES UNAVAILABLE AND SOME SURFACE PRINTS NOTHING AT ALL - HOWEVER THE SOURCE IS REACHED, AND WHETHER THE FAILURE RAISES OR BLOCKS', with `A MODULE LOAD IS A READ that none of those primitives names' said in as many words, the rule quantified over the thirteen declared read units, the ONE delegation boundary named, `NO declared source is loaded as a module by a hard-coded path anywhere in the pass' stated, and the surface assertions stated to run UNDER A TIMEOUT that counts a wedged surface as a failure. The narrower sentence is GONE and the handler rule is kept WITHIN the wider one (`WITHIN that rule every read of a recorded artifact still SITS INSIDE A HANDLER'), so nothing was dropped: the diff is 3 footprint lines and one replaced paragraph, +32/-9 over the file, and every deletion is inside the paragraph that was widened. TWO THINGS THE OWNER SHOULD SEE. FIRST, THE WIDENED SENTENCE IS WHAT CONVICTS THE ROUND. For three rounds the criterion was NARROWER than the property the item was judged on, and each reviewer had to argue that the harm was in scope. This round wrote the honest criterion - `HOWEVER THE SOURCE IS REACHED' - and R11-B1 is a declared source becoming unavailable, through a reach the sweep did not enumerate, with every surface printing nothing at all. There is no boundary argument left to have: the spec says it, and the measurement refutes it. That is progress in method even though it is a failure in outcome, and it should be said in that order. SECOND, the block asserts the rule over `the THIRTEEN declared sources' and the implementation asks the kind question over the units THIS PASS READS ITSELF. The gap between those two readings is the whole of R11-B1: a unit HANDED TO AN OWNER is reached through whatever roots that owner opens, and for specs/ the owner opens four more. A sentence that said `every root any owner opens on this pass's behalf' would have been the true statement of the same intent, and it is checkable from the same table.
notes: Ranked by six-month impact. 1. THE SWEEP'S KEY IS NOW RIGHT AND ITS DOMAIN IS STILL WRONG, and this is the fifth consecutive round where the domain is the finding rather than the mechanism. Round 8 keyed on recursion, round 9 on the exception classes, round 10 on thirteen read primitives, round 11 on the DECLARED TABLE - which is the correct key and I want to say that plainly, because it is the first key that cannot go stale when a new primitive is used.
